title: Rectangular QAM Demodulator Baseband
text: Demodulate rectangular-QAM-modulated data, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Decision type} sets Demodulation; {M-ary number} sets the modulation order, {Output type}, {Noise variance source}, {Noise variance}, {Constellation ordering} sets the mapping order, {Constellation mapping} sets the user-defined constellation mapping, {Normalization method} sets the scaling method for constellation Min. distance between, {Minimum distance} sets the distance between two nearest constellation, {Average power, referenced to 1 ohm (watts)}, {Peak power, referenced to 1 ohm (watts)} sets the maximum power, {Phase offset (rad)} sets the rotation of signal constellation, {Output data type}, {Derotate factor}, {Denormalization factor}, {Product output}, {Rounding mode}, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the option to saturate on integer overflow and {Sum}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Var
ports.summary: Noise Variance positive scalar | vector of positive values

params.name: Decision type
params.values: Demodulation decision type Hard decision (default) | Log-likelihood ratio | Approximate log-likelihood ratio

params.name: Noise variance
params.values: Noise Variance 1 (default) | positive scalar | vector of positive values

params.name: Constellation ordering
params.values: Mapping order of symbols Binary (default) | Gray | User-defined

params.name: Normalization method
params.values: Scaling method for constellation Min. distance between symbols (default) | Average Power | Peak Power

params.name: Minimum distance
params.values: Distance between two nearest constellation points 2 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Phase offset (rad)
params.values: Rotation of signal constellation 0 (default) | numeric scalar

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Output data type Inherit via internal rule (default) | Smallest unsigned integer | double | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | boolean

params.name: Derotate factor
params.values: Derotate factor data type Inherit: Same word length as input (default) | fixdt(1,16) |

params.name: Denormalization factor
params.values: Denormalization factor data type Inherit: Same word length as input (default) | fixdt(1,16) |

params.name: Product output
params.values: Product output data type Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | fixdt(1,16) |

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode for fixed-point operations Wrap (default) | Saturate

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Option to saturate on integer overflow off (default) | on

params.name: Sum
params.values: Sum data type Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt(1,16) |
